scope_note: Six reviewed historical exclusions only. Local snapshot labels are not independently verified tagged releases. Runtime validates selected indexed labels, statuses, cross-references and explicit variant side roles, not historical comments, subclass axioms or a global EC/GO retirement rule.

exclusions.subject: RHEA:15929
exclusions.historical_label: methylenediurea + 2 H2O + 2 H(+) = N-(hydroxymethyl)urea + 2 NH4(+) + CO2
exclusions.historical_context: 141 native comment: Multi-step reaction: RHEA:22240 + RHEA:11704 + RHEA:13901.
exclusions.selected_context: 142 adds RHEA:87283 to that native multistep comment and changes the reaction product and EC annotation. This is not a global EC identifier replacement.

required_native_assertions.subject: RHEA:15929
required_native_assertions.value: methylenediurea + 2 H2O + 2 H(+) = urea + formaldehyde + 2 NH4(+) + CO2

exclusions.subject: RHEA:19441
exclusions.historical_context: 141 explicitly annotates the subreaction with GO:0018581, not GO:0047074. Both RDF snapshots comment: RHEA:19441 part of RHEA:35595. GO:0018581 is deprecated with exact replacement GO:0047074; prior finalization applied that separate GO authority decision.
exclusions.selected_context: 142 has no GO annotation on RHEA:19441. Complete reaction RHEA:35595 retains GO:0047074; its native comment names the multistep composition RHEA:19441 + RHEA:42432. Do not replace the reaction subject or invalidate the independent GO retirement decision.

exclusions.subject: RHEA:22140
exclusions.historical_label: a nucleoside 5'-phosphate + H2O = a nucleoside + phosphate
exclusions.historical_context: 141 asserts the generic nucleotidase GO:0008252 annotation.
exclusions.selected_context: 142 explicitly asserts GO:0008253 (5'-nucleotidase activity). Reviewed local GO authority has GO:0008253 subclass_of GO:0008252 and exact match RHEA:22140. The broader biological relationship is not declared false; no new direct annotation is inferred from hierarchy.

required_native_assertions.subject: RHEA:22140
required_native_assertions.value: a nucleoside 5'-phosphate + H2O = a nucleoside + phosphate

exclusions.subject: RHEA:28338
exclusions.historical_context: 141 asserts GO:0008735 (L-carnitine CoA-transferase activity) on this EC:4.2.1.149 reaction.
exclusions.selected_context: 142 instead asserts GO:0140427 (crotonobetainyl-CoA hydratase activity). RHEA:28526 retains the CoA-transferase annotation GO:0008735 and EC:2.8.3.21. No general GO identifier replacement is inferred.

exclusions.subject: RHEA:47152
exclusions.historical_context: 141 asserts generic aldehyde dehydrogenase GO:0004029. Both RDF snapshots have RHEA:47152 subClassOf RHEA:16185.
exclusions.selected_context: 142 asserts GO:0044104 for the specific substrate. Reviewed GO authority has GO:0044104 subclass_of GO:0004029. Generic parent reaction RHEA:16185 retains GO:0004029; neither reaction identity nor a new direct annotation is inferred.

required_native_assertions.subject: RHEA:16185
required_native_assertions.value: an aldehyde + NAD(+) + H2O = a carboxylate + NADH + 2 H(+)

exclusions.subject: RHEA:58872
exclusions.historical_label: 24-methylidenelophenol + 2 Fe(II)-[cytochrome b5] + O2 + 2 H(+) = 4alpha-hydroxymethyl-ergosta-7,24(24(1))-dien-3beta-ol + 2 Fe(III)-[cytochrome b5] + H2O
exclusions.historical_context: 141 asserts GO:0102177 on RHEA:58872, not RHEA:58868. Both snapshots comment: RHEA:58872 part of RHEA:58868; complete-reaction composition is RHEA:58872 + RHEA:58876 + RHEA:58880.
exclusions.selected_context: 142 asserts GO:0102177 on complete reaction RHEA:58868, not subreaction RHEA:58872. The complete reaction consumes six Fe(II)-cytochromes and three O2 and produces the carboxy product. Do not collapse the two native reaction identities.
